name: TC-14-server-actions
description: TC-14: Server Actions — Navigate to entities that support server actions (Clone Asset, Calculate RPN, Generate Templates)

doc_metadata.title: TC-14.1 — Asset List (Clone Action)
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Asset. The 'Clone Asset' server action creates a copy of an existing asset with a new ID and reset fields.

doc_metadata.title: TC-14.1 — Assets for Cloning
doc_metadata.caption: Select an asset from the list to access server actions. The 'Clone Asset' action is available from the asset detail page's action menu.

doc_metadata.title: TC-14.2 — Failure Analysis List (RPN Calculation)
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Failure Analysis. Server actions include 'Calculate RPN' (Risk Priority Number = Severity × Occurrence × Detection), 'Generate 5-Why Template', and 'Generate Fishbone Template'.

doc_metadata.title: TC-14.2 — Failure Analysis Overview
doc_metadata.caption: The failure analysis list shows all failure records with their severity, occurrence, detection ratings, and calculated RPN scores.

doc_metadata.title: TC-14.5 — Maintenance Request (Generate MO)
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Maintenance Request. The 'Generate Maintenance Order' server action creates a maintenance order with linked work order from an approved MR.

doc_metadata.title: TC-14.5 — MR Server Actions
doc_metadata.caption: Approved maintenance requests support server actions: 'Generate Maintenance Order' (creates MO + WO) and 'Create Purchase Request' (creates PR for required parts).

doc_metadata.title: TC-14.5 — Maintenance Order List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Maintenance Order. Maintenance orders are generated from approved maintenance requests and link to work orders for execution.

doc_metadata.title: TC-14.5 — Maintenance Order Overview
doc_metadata.caption: The maintenance order list shows all generated orders with their source MR, linked WO, status, and assigned resources.
